# ReportForge 2.0

> Universal Document Composition and PDF Engine in Rust Core v2.0. In-process vector rendering in 15-35 ms, zero Chromium, with native C ABI and SDKs for C#, TypeScript, Java, PHP, and Python.

## Quick Summary
ReportForge is a high-performance, in-process document and PDF generation engine written 100% in Rust. It eliminates the need for headless browsers (Chromium/Puppeteer), heavy Python microservices, and external databases. Applications in C#, Node.js, Bun, Java, PHP, and Python call ReportForge directly in memory via FFI/C ABI or using official client SDKs.

## Key Capabilities & Benchmarks
- **Generation Speed**: ~15 ms to 35 ms per single page; under 150 ms for complex multi-page invoices.
- **RAM Footprint**: ~14 MB to 24 MB peak memory usage (vs 500 MB+ in Chromium).
- **Execution Mode**: In-process native dynamic library (`reportforge.dll` on Windows, `libreportforge.so` on Linux).
- **Typography & Encoding**: Full Spanish accent and Unicode support (`á, é, í, ó, ú, ñ, Ñ, ¿, ¡, €`) through WinAnsi CP1252 hexadecimal encoding conforming to ISO 32000-1.
- **Visual Components**: Text, Tables (with pagination and repeat headers), Columns, Rows, Containers, QR Codes, Barcodes (Code128), Spacers, Dividers, Page Numbers.

## Official Resources
- [Interactive Playground & Portal](index.html): Live interactive web demo and package downloads.
- [Official Master Manual PDF](packages/ReportForge_Manual_Oficial_Completo.pdf): 13-page technical manual with architectural diagrams and component specifications.
- [Component Reference Guide](COMPONENTS_REFERENCE.md): Detailed JSON schema properties for each component.
- [Rust Core Specification](RUST_CORE_V2.md): Low-level documentation of the Rust rendering engine.

## Document JSON Schema Specification

```json
{
  "page": {
    "size": "A4",
    "orientation": "portrait",
    "margin": 36.0,
    "margin_top": 36.0,
    "margin_bottom": 36.0,
    "margin_left": 36.0,
    "margin_right": 36.0
  },
  "header": {
    "type": "text",
    "value": "Factura Comercial",
    "font_size": 18.0,
    "bold": true,
    "color": "#0066FF"
  },
  "content": [
    {
      "type": "text",
      "value": "Cliente: Acrópolis Center • RNC: 101-00000-1",
      "font_size": 11.0
    },
    { "type": "spacer", "height": 10.0 },
    {
      "type": "table",
      "repeat_header": true,
      "zebra": true,
      "columns": [
        { "title": "Descripción", "field": "desc", "width": 220.0 },
        { "title": "Cant.", "field": "qty", "width": 60.0 },
        { "title": "Precio Unit.", "field": "price", "width": 100.0 },
        { "title": "Total", "field": "total", "width": 100.0 }
      ],
      "data": [
        { "desc": "Licencia ReportForge v2.0", "qty": "1", "price": "$999.00", "total": "$999.00" },
        { "desc": "Soporte Técnico 24/7", "qty": "12", "price": "$50.00", "total": "$600.00" }
      ]
    },
    { "type": "spacer", "height": 15.0 },
    {
      "type": "row",
      "items": [
        { "type": "qr", "value": "https://dgii.gov.do/facturacion/e-CF", "size": 65.0 },
        { "type": "barcode", "value": "FAC2026-9901", "barcode_type": "CODE128", "height": 35.0 }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "footer": {
    "type": "text",
    "value": "Documento emitido con ReportForge Rust Core • Página 1 de 1",
    "font_size": 8.0,
    "color": "#64748B",
    "alignment": "center"
  }
}
```

## SDK Installation and Code Examples

### 1. C# (.NET 8/9/10)
Package: `packages/ReportForge.2.0.0.nupkg`
```bash
dotnet add package ReportForge --source ./docs/packages
```
```csharp
using ReportForge;

var doc = ReportDocument.Create(page => page.Size("A4").Margin(36))
    .Header(h => h.Text("Factura C#").FontSize(18).Bold().Color("#0066FF"))
    .Content(c => {
        c.Text("Total: € 1,599.00 con acentos: á, é, í, ó, ú, ñ").FontSize(11);
        c.Spacer(10);
        c.Table(t => {
            t.RepeatHeader();
            t.Columns(cols => {
                cols.Add("Producto", width: 200);
                cols.Add("Precio", width: 100);
            });
            t.AddRow("Servidor Rust Core", "$ 350.00");
        });
        c.Qr("https://reportforge.dev", size: 60);
    });

byte[] pdf = doc.GeneratePdf();
File.WriteAllBytes("factura_csharp.pdf", pdf);
```

### 2. TypeScript / JavaScript (Node.js / Bun)
Package: `packages/reportforge-2.0.0.tgz`
```bash
npm install ./docs/packages/reportforge-2.0.0.tgz
```
```typescript
import { ReportDocument } from "reportforge";
import * as fs from "fs";

const doc = ReportDocument.create({ size: "A4", margin: 36 })
  .header(h => h.text("Reporte TypeScript", { fontSize: 18, bold: true, color: "#0066FF" }))
  .content(c => {
    c.text("Renderizado vectorial in-process en ~25 ms");
    c.spacer(10);
    c.qr("https://reportforge.dev", { size: 60 });
  });

const pdfBuffer = doc.generatePdf();
fs.writeFileSync("reporte.pdf", pdfBuffer);
```

### 3. Java (Java 11+)
Package: `packages/reportforge-2.0.0.jar`
```bash
mvn install:install-file -Dfile=docs/packages/reportforge-2.0.0.jar -DgroupId=dev.reportforge -DartifactId=reportforge -Dversion=2.0.0 -Dpackaging=jar
```
```java
import dev.reportforge.ReportDocument;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;

ReportDocument doc = ReportDocument.create(page -> page.size("A4").margin(36.0f))
    .header(h => h.text("Factura Java").fontSize(18.0f).bold(true).color("#0066FF"))
    .content(c => {
        c.text("Generado vía JNA embebido en el JAR");
        c.qr("https://reportforge.dev", 60.0f);
    });

byte[] pdfBytes = doc.generatePdf();
try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream("factura.pdf")) {
    fos.write(pdfBytes);
}
```

### 4. PHP (PHP 8.0+)
Package: `packages/reportforge-php-2.0.0.zip`
```php
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';
use ReportForge\ReportDocument;

$doc = ReportDocument::create(['size' => 'A4', 'margin' => 36])
    ->header(fn($h) => $h->text("Factura PHP")->fontSize(18)->bold(true)->color("#0066FF"))
    .content(function($c) {
        $c->text("Documento emitido con PHP FFI en 25ms");
        $c->qr("https://reportforge.dev", 60);
    });

$pdfBytes = $doc->generatePdf();
file_put_contents("factura.pdf", $pdfBytes);
```

### 5. Native Rust
```rust
use reportforge::ast::DocumentDefinitionAst;
use reportforge::pdf_engine::PdfEngine;

let json_str = r#"{"page":{"size":"A4","margin":36.0},"content":{"type":"text","value":"Rust Core v2.0"}}"#;
let ast: DocumentDefinitionAst = serde_json::from_str(json_str).unwrap();
let engine = PdfEngine::new();
let pdf_bytes = engine.render(&ast, None).unwrap();
std::fs::write("output.pdf", pdf_bytes).unwrap();
```

## C ABI / FFI Interface
For other languages (C, C++, Go, Python ctypes, Swift, Ruby):
```c
typedef struct {
    uint8_t* data;
    size_t length;
    bool success;
    char* error_message;
} ReportForgeResult;

ReportForgeResult reportforge_render_pdf(const char* doc_json, const char* data_json);
void reportforge_free_result(ReportForgeResult result);
const char* reportforge_version(void);
```
